messages.subject: Midnight to midnight Part.4
parts:
Hi all, 

I am looking to run an analysis similar to the one in the below link

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168822724007964

The main stumbling block is the two sleep variables that were used in the analysis (sleep time and WASO) which are taken from the Part 4 output. My understanding is that the standard Part 4 analysis analyses the sleep data from wake time to wake time. Whereas for this particular piece of analysis, they analysed all GGIR parts using a midnight to midnight time frame so that inactivity + activity + sleep would always perfectly total 1440 minutes, meaning the isotemporal substitution is bound by 24 h.

I realise that Part 5 already generates some MM data, however, this only gives the total sleep period rather than the two variables mentioned above. Is there a way to get WASO/sleep time in MM part.5 or pump out MM part.4? 

thanks in advance 

James

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Midnight to midnight Part.4
parts:
Hi James,

You are referring to a publication, so first step should be that you contact the authors and ask them to clarify how they did their analysis. It is their responsibility to document clearly how analysis were done.

Best,

Vincent
